notes.title: Hello, version 1.0!
notes.notes:
After more than a year of EA period, we have finally finished the content of High School Odyssey, fixed hundreds of bugs, and added English support.

The current version of High School Odyssey has more game content than the version a year ago, and is more robust and less prone to crash.

We'd like to thank everyone who purchased the game during the EA period. It's because of your support and suggestions that High School Odyssey was able to successfully complete the EA and go live.

In the future, we will continue to collect bugs and fix them in a timely manner. We will also consider some game content with high player willingness, these features still need to be thoughtfully considered before we can decide whether to make them or not due to some policy reasons and ethical issues. These include Steam workshop, NSFW content, and more. If you have good suggestions, welcome to join our steam community to discuss.

In addition, it is currently the first week of High School Odyssey on sale, there will be a 20% discount. Do not hesitate to rush with us into the wonderful Odyssey of high school.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1353920

notes.title: English support is available for High School Odyssey now!
notes.notes:
High School Odyssey has been in development for several years, and during those years it has been available only in Chinese, but beyond the voices of the Chinese-speaking players, we have also heard from players in the wider English-speaking world. There are many non-native Chinese speakers who are very interested in this game, yet are deterred by the lack of English support for this game.

Well, for those players, we have good news: 
[b]High School Odyssey finally supports English now! [/b]
In game, you can now use English to talk to the girls, make more friends and dominate the whole campus.

Due to the large amount of text in the game, translation is a very heavy and difficult job. With the help of our good friends, we finally finished translating the game text. However, due to our limited level, some translations may not be perfect. If you find any inaccuracies in the translation, please let us know in the steam community and we'll fix them in time.

Ok, now please enter the English version of the game world and enjoy your magical campus journey!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1353920/_/

notes.title: 那个叫“李雷”的外卖小哥，你在哪，我们要送你一份游戏
notes.notes:
咱们的玩家群里永远不会缺少故事。今天，又有一位群友给我们讲了这样一个故事：

[i]中午，我（群友）点了一份外卖，然后打开电脑玩《李雷和韩梅梅》游戏。游戏玩起来，时间就过得飞快，正玩得起劲，外头传来了敲门声，我的外卖到了。门外是一个青涩的小哥，戴着一副眼镜，头上满是汗珠，他微笑着将外卖递给我后，目光瞥了一眼桌上的电脑屏幕，问我玩的是什么游戏。

我告诉他那是《李雷和韩梅梅》。他的眼睛突然一亮。他的年纪跟我差不多，我猜他在业余时间大概也是一个游戏高手。不过跟他寒喧几句后，他告诉我他早就不玩游戏了，因为没有时间。最近疫情紧，收入下降很多，为了挣钱养家，只得拼命；如果运气不好，进入小区送餐后碰巧小区因疫情封闭了，还要损失几天的收入。生，容易，活，容易；生活，不容易啊。

看着他远去的背影，我忍不住打开了外卖APP，想给他打个五星好评。然而看到他的名字时，我愣住了：原来他的名字就叫“李雷”，难怪刚才我告诉他《李雷和韩梅梅》游戏时，他会眼睛一亮。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38198474/792c286bb902cea856185991bfce39401ac46dd3.jpg[/img]

李雷小哥，祝你好运。希望疫情早日结束，希望你可以赚到更多的钱，希望你也能有业余时间，可以玩一玩《李雷和韩梅梅》游戏。[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38198474/e3b15b9a10c2c7c599957a8c283e9be169973bee.jpg[/img]
这位群友的故事让我们很感动。疫情第三年了，依旧没有好转；经济的颓势，最容易影响的就是像这位李雷小哥这样的底层人群。虽然生活依旧艰难，但幸好我们还有游戏，它让我们暂时忘记生活的苦楚，得以享受珍贵的快乐。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38198474/2ceb7ad2d46eaa4a0d87635360027af9ee22e4fe.jpg[/img]

李雷小哥，我们愿意赠送你一套《李雷和韩梅梅》游戏，你可以在任何方便的时候游玩。这是我们向伟大的人们致敬的一种方式。有人说你们很普通，但在我看来你们很伟大。

为生活而奋力拼搏的人，很伟大。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38198474/9a093bf9ecd8ac9529e952a7c9ea448f9f504fc1.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Development Story (2)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, this is Ourshow Games, a small indie-game team. Today I want to talk to you about ourselves.

In the autumn of 2020, our independent game team started the development of our first steam game project: Lilei And Hanmeimei. All the members of our team are unprofessional and none of us had been working in a game company. The members of our team are:

programmer: A Niu. As a middle school teacher for five years, he learned programming by himself.

Artist: Ken. Graduated from a technical secondary school, did a blackboard newspaper design when he was a student. After working, it is said that he has followed an expert as a teacher, and learned to use an ancient drawing tool called Fireworks. But for PS, no.

Game Designer: Guoguo. A young girl who works in a small county TV station as program planner, although she loves to play games, this is her first time designing games.

Investor: Master Wang, the pancake seller downstairs, kindly sponsors three pancakes to us.

Located in a small county in the south of China, none of us have ever worked in a game company, so we started a wonderful journey of independent games development.

(To be continued)

notes.title: Development anecdote (1)
notes.notes:
Our game has been in continuous development for more than a year, during which several demos have been released. A few months ago, a player asked me whether a mobile game called "全民X霸" was made by us.

I told him that I had never heard of that game, and never participated in the development of that game. Then, that player sent me a picture, which really made me dumbfounded.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38198474/588a68771cc0c52ebe5ec83d39ef47b5b2f09121.jpg[/img]
In the advertisement of the mobile game called "全民X霸", the UI interface is almost the same as our game. Some players may think it is a promotional poster for our game.

I have also heard about the embezzlement of other game resources by some domestic game manufacturers. Just recently, "God of War" game director Cory Barlog tweeted a copy of "God of War" promotional image, and said: "This (game) is better."

This promotional image is from a Chinese mobile game, and its background, characters and composition are almost exactly the same as the official promotional image of "God of War".
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38198474/ff13723bedd7cc2b32a71e2907c189cafd16c9b5.jpg[/img]
The materials that were stolen by domestic game companies before were those international 3A game masterpieces. But I really did not expect them to be so rampant, even our unknown indie game that has not been officially launched. It can only be said that these game companies really have the ability to find materials.

Our small studio is weak and unable to contend with those game makers who embezzle materials. We can only make some small protests here, hoping that they will find it conscientiously and turn back.

However, looking at the happy appearance of these companies counting money, I am afraid we will see more plagiarized advertisements of this kind in the future.
